note: T6 conference calendar. A date is filled in only when it was read from the society's own page; source_url (and date_sources per field) records where. Milestones: abstract_open/close/notification/release and late_breaker_open/close/notification/release -- *_release is the embargo lift. A milestone the society has not published stays null and the internal report lists it as 未公布. An entry with "verified": false is inert: liver_intel.conference refuses to open a window or tag an item from it.
